svg.title: InnerAura
svg.desc: InnerAura footer, light: a quantized topographic terrain rendered as hard-edged contour bands in orchid, mint, chartreuse and cobalt, with an ordered 4px square-dot dither carrying every band transition, and INNERAURA in Orbitron outlines cut as a window onto the same terrain in a submerged palette.

hw:lineage.note: replaces the cloned cherenkov caustic; new pattern, new motion, new chromatic theory

hw:chromatic.contrast-ratio: >7.4:1 letter mass on mist, >5:1 on the darkest field token
hw:chromatic.theory: quantized-ordered-dither — hard-edge level sets, anti-gradient, five tokens on one height field

hw:material.surface: quantized terrain under a fixed halftone screen

hw:reasoning.hw:intent: Replace the cloned hero caustic with a genuinely different material: a different pattern, a different motion vocabulary and a different chromatic theory, built to the Topographic Dither Matrix DNA and set in Orbitron.
hw:reasoning.hw:approach: The pattern is a level-set map, not a light field. One fractal height field is stretched and then quantized through a six-entry discrete LUT built from feComponentTransfer — the per-channel tableValues are literally the five palette tokens, so colour is assigned by elevation and every edge is hard. That is the anti-gradient doctrine enforced structurally rather than by restraint: the file contains no linearGradient or radialGradient element at all. The dither is real ordered dithering, not a texture. Two further passes quantize the same height field with the threshold offset by a third and two thirds of a level, then mask through 4px square-dot patterns at 50 and 25 percent coverage. Where the shifted quantization agrees with the base the dots are invisible; where it disagrees, which is only near a contour, dots of the neighbouring band appear. The interfacial halo therefore emerges from the arithmetic instead of being drawn. Motion is rebuilt on a different principle: the screen is fixed to the substrate as a halftone screen physically is, and the terrain drifts beneath it, so colour flows through stationary dots rather than dots flowing across colour. Three near layers share one drift so their contours stay locked; a blurred, lower-contrast far terrain on a separate seed drifts at 97 seconds against the near set at 58, giving parallax depth. A slow opacity tide on the dither passes makes the halo advance and recede, which reads as the level set migrating. Every animation is CSS transform or opacity, so every filter in the file is static and rasterizes exactly once — unlike the hero, which re-renders its whole filter chain each frame — and prefers-reduced-motion genuinely stops the motion. Typography is real Orbitron: the variable font pinned to weight 700 and the nine glyphs converted to outlines, so the artifact stays self-contained with no webfont dependency and no full font embedded. The word is cut as a clip window onto the same terrain under a submerged LUT, so the topography is continuous across the letterform edge while the palette inside it drops below the waterline.
hw:reasoning.hw:tradeoffs: The palette is nearly all high-luminance, which the type has to survive: measured against the tokens, cobalt at 17.6 percent relative luminance clears 4.20:1 on mist but only 2.64:1 on orchid and 2.86:1 on chartreuse, under the 3:1 large-text floor. The letter LUT therefore does not use the cobalt token as its mass — it uses two derived darkenings, #16296B and #2647A8 at 12.1:1 and 7.5:1 on mist, with the cobalt token demoted to a highlight level and a single mint glint at the ridge top. Those two shades are derived, not tokens, and should be added to the DNA if this ships. Six filtered full-canvas layers is the highest count in the family; they are static so the cost is one-time rather than per-frame, but first paint is heavier than anything else here and the far parallax layer is the first to cut. The LUT intercepts that decide how much area each token gets were set analytically and not visually verified — area distribution is normal, not uniform, so token weights will not match the DNA's stated 0.32 / 0.28 / 0.15 / 0.14 / 0.11 without tuning the two intercept values, which is the single dial to turn. Ordered dither at a fixed 4px grid does not scale: rendered at half size the dots alias into moire, so this artifact has a minimum display width and should not be used as a responsive banner without regenerating the grid. Vignettes are gone entirely — the reference is edge to edge and a fade would reintroduce the gradient the doctrine forbids — so the terrain meets the frame as a hard cut. Orbitron outlines mean the word cannot be re-typed without rerunning the conversion.
hw:reasoning.hw:spatial-notes: Canvas 1200x220, substrate mist #FCF0FA. Wordmark INNERAURA in Orbitron wght 700 converted to outlines at 133px with 0.10em tracking, spanning exactly x95 to x1105, cap band y62.1 to baseline y157.9, cap height 95.8. Terrain rects overscan to -120,-120,1440x460 against a maximum drift of 46px so no edge is ever exposed. Dither lattice 4px, square dots, 50 percent checker and 25 percent single-cell. Near drift 58s ping-pong, far drift 97s, level-set tide 17.944s. Six LUT levels at intercepts -0.520 for the field and -0.780 for the submerged letter palette, offset by a third, two thirds and a half level for the dither passes.
